{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning her rehearsed wish in front of the assembly and redirecting her First Sacrifice toward Lirael, blurring the wound’s name to avoid direct recognition—while the presiding Dohkar’s judgmental gaze lingers on the misalignment, and Julian watches from the edge of the gathering without intervening.",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters as she names her offering aloud, her fingers tightening around the spiralgrass beneath her knees—then she shifts her gaze to Lirael and begins the invocation wrong.",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The presiding Dohkar’s lips part, but no sound comes out—his eyes narrow as Seren’s words twist the ritual’s alignment.",
      "Lirael’s breath catches behind the muffling band as she realizes the wish is being rewritten in front of her, the cost now tied to her instead of Seren’s earliest memory."
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she pull the band away and cry out—breaking protocol to halt the wish—or let the assembly witness the sacrifice twist toward her, risking the Dohkar’s disapproval?",
    "pc_career": "Veilweave tailor",
    "opening_setting": "ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the deep-crimson carpet of braided spiralgrass beneath Seren’s knees, stilling her trembling hands",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ leaf-curtains swaying above, catching the dawn light like a veil of whispered secrets"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": null,
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "beat 1: She tucks her ceremonial sash tighter under her arm, the embroidered thread catching the light as she forces herself to stand—*this is what she was trained for*—but her pulse jumps where the band muffles her voice.",
    "scene_want": "She wants the Dohkar to see her as the one who can correct the wish—not as the one it’s being redirected toward.",
    "scene_mission": "Convince the presiding Dohkar the wish has twisted before he calls for the cost to be spoken aloud, using only her eyes and the band’s muffled cry.",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is mid-invocation, the ritual’s alignment is shifting, and Lirael is the officiating Sacrificiant with her mouth covered by a ceremonial band.",
      "believes": "The sacrifice’s cost is about to land on Lirael instead of Seren, and the Dohkar’s judgment will decide whether the wish twists or is halted.",
      "wondering": "Why is Seren choosing to blur the wound’s name—and why does Lirael feel the cost in her own body?",
      "must_not_confuse": "The band is decorum, not magic; pulling it away breaks protocol, not a spell; the Dohkar’s disapproval is procedural, not personal."
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "beat 2: stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring—her fingers curl around the spiralgrass, knuckles whitening as she fights the urge to reach for the band)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2: focus_tell (Julian’s stillness—his posture doesn’t shift as Seren’s gaze lands on Lirael, but his fingers flex once against his thigh, the only sign he’s tracking the shift)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ],
    "scene_skeleton": {
      "character_plus": [
        {
          "character": "Seren",
          "mode": "IN_PERSON",
          "option_id": "OPT-4",
          "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
          "visible_action": "She names her offering aloud—then hesitates, her voice wavering as she omits the wound’s name, instead weaving Lirael’s name into the invocation’s fabric.",
          "behavior_object_ids": ["O3"],
          "behavior_person_ids": [],
          "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
          "pc_interpretation": "Seren is choosing to soften the wound’s edge for Lirael’s sake, even if it twists the wish."
        },
        {
          "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
          "mode": "IN_PERSON",
          "option_id": "OPT-8",
          "expression_mode": "TEST",
          "visible_action": "He watches Seren’s lips move, then glances at Lirael—his jaw tightens as he realizes the wish’s alignment has shifted, but he says nothing, waiting for the cost to be named.",
          "behavior_object_ids": [],
          "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren", "pc:lirael"],
          "pc_lens_operation": "EMOTIONAL_CONCLUSION_BEFORE_EVIDENCE",
          "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar assumes his judgment carries authority here, and he’s already deciding whether to correct her—or let the wish proceed."
        }
      ],
      "environment_plus": {
        "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided spiralgrass",
        "axis": "damage",
        "beat": "The carpet’s fibers are frayed where Seren’s knees pressed into it during rehearsals, but now they part unevenly beneath her shifting weight as she redirects her gaze toward Lirael."
      },
      "pc_opening_fusion": {
        "character": "Lirael",
        "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
        "character_angle": "Her first embodied action reveals her as someone who has spent months memorizing ritual order—yet now, with the wish twisting, she’s the one who must decide whether to speak or stay silent.",
        "environment_target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided spiralgrass",
        "environment_axis": "use",
        "beat": "She presses her palms into the carpet, anchoring herself as Seren’s voice falters, the spiralgrass’s texture grounding her while her breath hitches behind the band."
      }
    }
  }
